Taxable income for the Northwest Territories.

Amount 1F. Income eligible for the Northwest Territories lower tax rate. Amount 1E multiplied by the result of taxable income for the Northwest Territories divided by taxable income for all provinces. Instance 1.
Amount 1G. Income subject to the Northwest Territories higher tax rate. Amount 1A minus amount 1F. Instance 1.

Amount 2B. Northwest Territories tax at the higher rate. Amount 1G multiplied by 11.5%.
Amount 2C. Northwest Territories tax before credits. Amount 2A plus amount 2B.
